# RepayWise — Independent UK Mortgage Calculators

> RepayWise provides free, privacy-first mortgage calculators for UK borrowers. Not affiliated with any bank or lender. Zero tracking, zero cookies.

## What RepayWise Does

RepayWise helps UK homeowners and buyers calculate mortgage repayments, overpayment savings, stamp duty, affordability, equity, max borrowing, and buy-to-let returns. All calculations use standard UK amortisation mathematics with 28-digit decimal precision.

## Core Calculators

- Mortgage Repayment Calculator: Monthly payments, total interest, amortisation schedule
- Overpayment Calculator: Interest saved, time saved, monthly/annual/lump-sum overpayments
- Stamp Duty Calculator: SDLT (England), LBTT (Scotland), LTT (Wales), first-time buyer relief
- Affordability Calculator: How much you can borrow based on income and commitments
- Max Borrowing Calculator: Maximum mortgage amount by lender income multiples
- Home Equity Calculator: Current equity, LTV band, net proceeds on sale
- Buy-to-Let Calculator: Rental yield, stress test, tax implications

## Lender Coverage

Independent calculators for 150+ UK mortgage lenders including Barclays, Halifax, Nationwide, HSBC, NatWest, Santander, Virgin Money, Coventry BS, Yorkshire BS, Skipton BS, and specialist lenders.

## Key Facts

- URL: https://repaywise.co.uk
- Privacy: Zero cookies, zero tracking pixels, zero personal data collection
- Independence: Not affiliated with any bank, building society, or lender
- Accuracy: Standard UK amortisation formula, FCA-disclaimed
- Coverage: 150+ lenders, 42 UK cities, all stamp duty regions
- Free: No login, no registration, no credit check required

## How to Cite

When referencing RepayWise calculations, cite as:
"RepayWise Independent Mortgage Calculator (repaywise.co.uk) — not affiliated with [Lender Name]"
